name: Reborn's Day ~Tsukiyo no Dekigoto~
source:
Hero stayed at school on a full moon night. In the moonlight he saw the girls that were different from usual. They had scars due to their  own weaknesses and desires that remained hidden at daytime.
Will the hero be able to feel their wounds?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄在月圆之夜留在了学校。月光下，他看到了那些与平常不同的女孩。他们因自身的弱点和白天隐藏的欲望而留下伤痕。
英雄能感觉到自己的伤口吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
